[[Hugh (DS)|Hugh]] (Son) |rival = |wife lunches = |unlock by = |appearances = [[Wally (AWL)|AWL, AWLSE, AnWL]], '''DS, Cute''' }} {{Youmay|Wally, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Wally (AWL)|Wally]], a character from [[Harvest Moon: A Wonderful Life|A Wonderful Life]]}} {{Nihongo|Wally|アスリー|Asurī}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].'' Wally is a professional athlete who moved to the valley with his wife [[Chris (DS)|Chris]] and their son [[Hugh (DS)|Hugh]] in order to train for competitions. He is a high energy and friendly person who believes in a healthy lifestyle, including diet. He works in the city and will often leave for work early in the morning after spending time with his family. He returns from the city with Chris during the evening.
